Why use Crew?

The safest way to hire and get hired for home services — built-in protection for customers, contractors and organisations.

📸

Photo verification on every job

Before & after photos are captured by the contractor and shared with you instantly. You see exactly what was done before payment is released.

🔒

Escrow-protected payments

Your money is held in secure escrow until you approve the work. You never pay directly to a stranger's account — the platform holds the funds safely.

⚖️

Fair dispute resolution

If something goes wrong, our team mediates using GPS timestamps, job photos and job notes as evidence. Decisions are fair for both sides.

✅

Verified, insured contractors only

Every contractor is identity-verified before going live. Licence and insurance checks are required for licensed trades — no shortcuts.

⭐

Ratings you can trust

Reviews are only posted after a verified completed job. Contractors cannot remove or inflate ratings — what you see is real.

🤝

Fair for contractors too

Instant payouts, transparent low commission, and clear dispute protection mean contractors are motivated to deliver their best work every time.

Trust & Safety

Every payment on Crew is held in a secure, neutral escrow account — your funds are never transferred directly until the work is done. Release only happens when both the client and the service provider confirm the job is complete, giving every party full confidence before money changes hands. And if something doesn't go as planned, our structured dispute resolution process ensures every claim is reviewed fairly, with clear timelines and a dedicated resolution team on your side.

Add Crew to your Home Screen

Crew runs as a full-screen web app on iPhone and iPad — no App Store or download required. Follow these steps in Safari.

  1. 1

    Open Safari and navigate to getcrew.com.au Must be Safari — Chrome and other iOS browsers cannot install PWAs.

  2. 2

    Tap the Share button in the bottom Safari toolbar — the box with an arrow pointing up.

  3. 3

    Scroll the share sheet and tap "Add to Home Screen". You can rename the shortcut before confirming.

  4. 4

    Tap Add — Crew appears on your Home Screen as a native-style icon and opens full screen with no browser chrome.
